description: Benchmark sampling, warmup, statistical, order-bias, and outlier policy

warmup.description: Number of discarded warmup iterations before measured samples

sampling.description: Minimum number of measured (post-warmup) samples per scenario-comparator cell

statistical_method.description: Report median, IQR, and 95% bootstrap CI for central tendency

order_bias.description: Comparators are run in randomised-interleaved order per iteration to reduce ordering bias
order_bias.seed_description: Deterministic seed derived from run_id for reproducibility

outlier_policy.description: Flag outliers beyond 1.5*IQR from Q1/Q3; never silently drop

claim_thresholds.description: A performance winner claim requires meeting these conditions across run sets
